beats.line: The strongbox went into the river with a wrecked cart, and the Party goes to find it.
Whoever fished it out keeps it in a river-town hideout, and the Party takes it back unseen.
The box is carried home to its owners, and trouble finds the Party on the road.
Its owners will not pay until the box is proved whole.
The one who told the thieves where the cart would be is followed unseen through the town.
